pages.title: Glacial Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows, Crossbows$(br2)§lEffect: §r Charge speed is halved, and the parent arrow flies at 3.2× speed; on release it scatters 12 child arrows, dealing area damage and pulling in enemies on hit.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
